title: Local equational criterion for flatness of module sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $M$ be a sheaf of $A$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $M$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] if and only if the following holds: for every object $U$, integer $n\geq0$, and sections $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in A(U)$ and $s_1,\ldots,s_n\in M(U)$ with $\sum_{p=1}^n a_p s_p=0$, there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and, for each $i$, an integer $l_i\geq0$, sections $b_{ipq}\in A(U_i)$ and $t_{iq}\in M(U_i)$ ($1\leq p\leq n$, $1\leq q\leq l_i$), such that $s_p|_{U_i}=\sum_q b_{ipq}t_{iq}$ for every $p$ and $\sum_p a_p|_{U_i}b_{ipq}=0$ for every $q$.

proof.text: Apply the existing independent-universe equational criterion, specialized to the common universe u. Its flatness predicate is exactly IsFlatOnSite, and its conclusion uses covering sieves.

Under IsSiteForCoverings, every covering sieve contains an actual covering presieve. Prove this by induction on Precoverage.Saturate: a generating cover contains itself; the maximal sieve contains the identity cover; a pullback of a cover contains the chosen covering pullbacks from the site axioms; for transitivity choose a covering refinement over each distinct arrow of an initial covering presieve and bind them. Apply this to the covering sieve in the forward equational criterion and restrict its witnesses to that presieve.

Conversely generate a covering sieve from the presieve furnished by the hypothesis. An arrow of the generated sieve factors through a covering arrow. Restrict that arrow's finite coefficients and sections along the further factor. Functoriality and semilinearity preserve the section factorization, and preservation of sums and products by the ring restriction preserves the zero coefficient relation. The covering-sieve criterion now implies IsFlatOnSite.

theorem isFlat_iff_local_equationalCriterion
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : Precoverage C) (_hJ : J.IsSiteForCoverings)
    (A : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck CommRingCat.{u})
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J.toGrothendieck (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj A)) :
    IsFlatOnSite (J := J.toGrothendieck) (R := A) M ↔
      ∀ (U : C) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A.obj.obj (op U))
        (s : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U)),
        (∑ p : Fin n, a p • s p) = 0 →
        ∃ S : Presieve U, S ∈ J U ∧
          ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
            ∃ (l : ℕ) (b : Fin n → Fin l → A.obj.obj (op V))
              (t : Fin l → M.val.obj (op V)),
              (∀ p : Fin n, M.val.map f.op (s p) = ∑ q : Fin l, b p q • t q) ∧
              (∀ q : Fin l, (∑ p : Fin n, A.obj.map f.op (a p) * b p q) = 0)
lean.note: Restores precisely the IsFlatOnSite / IsSiteForCoverings interface already recorded in this node, with a complete proof from the existing covering-sieve criterion. The obsolete commented IsFlat interface and private proof chain are removed.
